text: …　こまった　ことに　むすめは　ひとの　まねが　すきでな！

structure.jp: ひとの　まねが　すきでな！

patterns.name: 〜ことに
patterns.explanation: A feeling word plus ことに at the start tells how the speaker feels about what he is about to say. こまった　ことに = 'the trouble is'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: で is the て-form of だ and leaves the sentence open to continue; な is an older man's 'you see'. すきでな = 'she likes it, you see, and'.
